coder_notes: Bevacizumab (D6 established GBM therapy) tested by a new intra-arterial route -> established_therapy_experiment; no other candidate, so S6 established_therapy_only. Mannitol given IA solely to disrupt the BBB -> delivery_enabling_agent (not a registered intervention but described as given to every experimental-arm patient). TERT promoter mutation, EGFR amplification and +7/-10 are listed only as alternative WHO CNS5 diagnostic criteria for IDH-wildtype GBM, not as separate entry requirements; not recorded as biomarker rows.
